title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Dollar-Cost Averaging in Practice

questions.text: What is the main advantage of using dollar‑cost averaging as an investment strategy?
options: It spreads purchases over time, reducing the impact of trying to time the market
It guarantees higher returns than investing a lump sum
It ensures you always buy at the lowest possible price
questions.explanation: Spreading purchases over time avoids the need to predict market peaks and troughs, which is the core benefit of dollar‑cost averaging.

questions.text: True or false: Dollar‑cost averaging eliminates the risk of loss in an investment.
questions.explanation: Even with regular contributions, the value of the investment can still decline, so risk is not removed.
